title: Two election laws, one year apart
sources: Lily Thomas v. Union of India (2013)

quiz.q: Preparation of electoral rolls is governed by:
quiz.why: Right. Electoral rolls fall under the 1950 Act.

lines.say: Passed a year apart, they do different jobs.

beats.say: Two laws run India's elections. Passed a year apart, they do different jobs.

lines.say: The 1950 Act deals with seats and electoral rolls: who votes, and where.
The 1951 Act covers how elections are run, who can stand, and corrupt practices.

items.sub: Conduct of elections, disqualification, corrupt practices

beats.say: The 1950 Act deals with seats and electoral rolls: who votes, and where. The 1951 Act covers how elections are run, who can stand, and corrupt practices.

lines.say: Under Section 8 of the 1951 Act, a conviction with 2 years or more in prison disqualifies a lawmaker.
For the jail term, and six years after release.

beats.say: Under Section 8 of the 1951 Act, a conviction with 2 years or more in prison disqualifies a lawmaker. For the jail term, and six years after release.

lines.say: Sitting members once had three months to appeal before losing their seat.
In Lily Thomas, 2013, the Supreme Court struck that protection down.
